This is the canonical reference for every `KIM_*` environment variable read by
the codebase (56 variables at last generation). The **Read in** column is
generated from the source; the **Description** column is hand-curated — edit it
here and re-run the generator, which preserves descriptions by variable name.
Variables marked "TODO — undocumented" are internal or not yet documented; verify against
the listed source files before relying on them.

| `KIM_AGENT_MAX_WALL_SECONDS` | `orchestrator/cli.py`, `orchestrator/scheduled_runner.py` | Self-watchdog wall-clock cap (seconds) for the agent process. Set only by the scheduled runner so detached scheduled agents self-terminate; never set for interactive desktop launches. |
| `KIM_API_KEY` | `cli/src/provider/bridge.rs`, `desktop/src-tauri/src/http_bridge/mod.rs`, `kimctl/__main__.py` | Auth token for the local in-app HTTP bridge (desktop) and for kimctl/CLI clients talking to it; the desktop falls back to `KIM_API_KEY=`/`RELAY_API_KEY=` lines in the project `.env`. |
| `KIM_APPROVAL_SOCK` | `mcp_server/approvals.py`, `orchestrator/approval_broker.py` | Path to the Unix-domain-socket HITL approval broker advertised by the orchestrator; the MCP server sends one-line JSON `tool_approval_request` messages over it and reads the accept/acceptForSession/decline decision. |
| `KIM_APPROVAL_TCP` | `mcp_server/approvals.py`, `orchestrator/approval_broker.py` | `127.0.0.1:<port>` loopback approval channel — Windows fallback for `KIM_APPROVAL_SOCK`. |
| `KIM_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_S` | `mcp_server/approvals.py`, `orchestrator/agent.py` | Backstop timeout in seconds (default 150) for an unresponsive approval broker; the broker's own 120 s resolver timeout normally fires first. |

| `KIM_BROWSER_RESPONSE_WAIT_S` | `orchestrator/providers/browser/site_configs.py` | Seconds (default 60) the browser provider waits for a web-chat response to *begin*; the longer generation wait applies once output starts. |
| `KIM_BROWSER_RESTORE_STATUS` | `orchestrator/providers/browser/prompt_builder.py`, `orchestrator/providers/browser/provider.py` | Set by the desktop when spawning against a restored browser thread; value `stored_thread` tells the provider the system prompt was already sent, so only delta messages are sent. |
| `KIM_CDP_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS` | `mcp_server/tools/web/browser.py` | Timeout in milliseconds (default 10000) for connecting Playwright to a browser over CDP. |

| `KIM_CODEX_SKIP_GIT_CHECK` | `orchestrator/codex_bridge_service.py` | `1` is the user's explicit opt-in (via the CLI y/N prompt) to let Codex run in a directory that is not a git repository. |

| `KIM_ENABLED_TOOL_TIERS` | `mcp_server/tool_tiers.py` | Comma-separated tier names exposing only those MCP tools (granular: file_read, file_write, shell, screen, web, mouse, keyboard, windows, git, code, search, memory; aliases: file, core, ui, browser). Unset/empty = all tools. Note `core` excludes `shell` — arbitrary execution is an explicit opt-in. |

| `KIM_HITL_RISK_THRESHOLD` | `cli/src/agentic.rs`, `desktop/src-tauri/src/task_spec.rs`, `mcp_server/policy.py`, `orchestrator/agent.py` (+2 more) | Risk threshold for the human-in-the-loop tool gate (e.g. `high` requires approval for high-risk tools like write_file/run_python/mouse/keyboard). Config `hitl_risk_threshold` wins. Unset = the threshold arm is inert; only argv escalation rules and hard denies gate calls (deliberate default). |
